## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks actually completed, including any known baseline failures.

## Required handoff checks

- [ ] This PR is ready for review, not a draft, unless the repository owner explicitly requested a draft.
- [ ] GitHub reports the branch as mergeable, with no unresolved in-scope checks, conflicts or review requirements.
- [ ] This PR does not create, enable or depend on Vercel configuration, deployments, previews, hooks, apps, checks, URLs or new `@vercel/*` dependencies.
- [ ] Existing OSIRIS behaviour changes and known limitations are stated explicitly.
